transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my family and folks around me keep saying I’m doing too much. I don’t really see it that way. I’m just trying to get things done — handling the move, getting the new garage built the right way, helping organize things at church, and still showing the younger guys at work how the job ought to be done. Feels to me like I’m the only one with enough drive right now.
Do you often find yourself acting on ideas or projects without taking the time to think them through?

Yeah… I guess I have been doing that. I put money down on the garage work and some equipment without really talking it through with my wife first. At the time it just felt like it needed to get done.

And I kept driving back and forth between the houses, rushing around, and pushing jobs at the plant even after people told me I was taking chances. I didn’t really stop and think it through like I probably should have.
Have you noticed yourself interrupting others or finishing their sentences for them?

Yes, I guess I have. Once I get going explaining what needs to be done, I just keep talking. My family says I talk right over them, and I’m going so fast they can’t even get a word in to tell me to stop.
Do you have trouble waiting in line or for your turn in situations?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that, to be honest. I don’t think waiting in line is the main thing people have been complaining about with me.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?

Yeah, I do. I can’t seem to sit in a chair for more than a few minutes. I’ll get up and start sorting boxes, or measuring things in the garage, or loading tools.

It feels like my body’s got a motor in it, like I need to be moving or heading back over to the old place to do something.
Do you have mood swings or find yourself getting angry or irritable easily?

Yes. I’ve been pretty up and down. One minute I’m joking around and feeling like I’m ten feet tall, like everybody should just get on board with what I’m doing. Then if my wife or my boy asks me some little question, I snap at them like they’re in my way. I know it’s been coming out sharp.
Do you often feel like you're more important or special than others?

I don’t know if I’d put it that way. I mean, sometimes I feel like I know what needs to be done and people should listen, but “more important” or “special”... I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about it like that.
Do you often have thoughts that you're superior to others or have a special destiny?

No, I don’t think like that. I mean, I get strong opinions sometimes and I feel like I’m right, but I wouldn’t say I’m superior or that I’ve got some special destiny. That sounds bigger than how I think about it.
Do you often put others' needs before your own to the point where you neglect your own well-being?
I’m not sure I’d say that. I mean, I try to help my family when I can, but I don’t think I usually neglect myself for other people like that.
Do you often use charm or manipulation to get what you want from others?
No, I wouldn’t say I do that. I try to be polite with people, but I don’t think I use charm or manipulate anybody to get my way.
Do you often find yourself sacrificing your own needs or desires to help others?
Not really, no. I’ll help people if they need it, especially family, but I don’t think I’m usually giving up my own needs or wants to do it.
Do you often feel like you have a lot of very good ideas that are better than most people's?
I don’t know. I mean, I have ideas like anybody else, but I don’t usually think they’re better than everyone else’s.
Do you often find yourself doing things for others even when you don't really want to?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ll do things for people sometimes even if it’s inconvenient, but not really when I flat-out don’t want to. Usually I can say no if I need to.
Do you often put your own interests or desires aside to avoid disappointing others?
Not often, no. I don’t really think about it that way. If I can help somebody I care about, I’ll try to, but I don’t usually set my own wants aside just because I’m worried they’ll be disappointed.
Do you often feel like your accomplishments or ideas are unusually impressive or deserving of recognition?

Not really, no. I mean, if I’ve done a good job at something, I’m glad about it, sure. But I don’t usually think my ideas or accomplishments are unusually impressive or that people ought to recognize me for them.
Do you often have trouble completing tasks or projects once you've started them?

Yes, I do. At the shop or even at home, it doesn’t take much—one clank, a truck going by, or a tool sitting where it shouldn’t be—and I’m off what I was doing. Then before I know it, I’ve got five things started and none of them finished.
Do you often act impulsively in your personal relationships, such as saying something you later regret?

Yes. Lately I’ve been pretty quick with my mouth. I’ll be feeling great, joking around, like I’ve got everything figured out, and then if my wife or my boy asks one little thing, I snap at them. It’s like I want everybody to either get on board with what I’m doing or get out of my way, and I do say things I regret after.
Do you often feel restless or have difficulty engaging in activities quietly?

Yes. I have a hard time sitting still. I’ll sit in a chair and within a few minutes I’m up again—sorting boxes, measuring stuff in the garage, loading tools, or deciding I need to head back to the old place. It feels like my body’s got a motor in it and I can’t just settle down.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt completely focused and able to complete tasks without getting distracted or feeling restless?

Not really, not lately. At the shop or even at home, it only takes one thing—a clank, a truck going by, or a tool sitting wrong—and I’m pulled off what I was doing. Then I look around and I’ve got five things started and none of them finished.
